name: Park UI
summary: Styled Ark UI components with Panda CSS; copy-paste/CLI source ownership for React.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 58 documented components (React docs paths).
Also supports Vue and Solid via Ark UI — catalog frameworks list React primary only.
Requires Panda CSS toolchain; not a drop-in Tailwind kit.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Styled Ark button with Park UI Panda recipes.

demo.peerNotes: Requires Panda CSS + @ark-ui/react + lucide-react. CLI: npx @park-ui/cli init && npx @park-ui/cli add {slug}.

components.copyCode:
npx @park-ui/cli init
npx @park-ui/cli add button
# peers: npm install @ark-ui/react lucide-react  (+ Panda CSS setup)

import { Button } from "@/components/ui"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use Park UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://park-ui.com/docs/components/button. Setup: Panda CSS, then `npm install @ark-ui/react lucide-react`, `npx @park-ui/cli init`, then `npx @park-ui/cli add button` (copies source into the project). Also supports Vue and Solid via Ark. Docs: https://park-ui.com/docs/installation. Home: https://park-ui.com. Repo: https://github.com/cschroeter/park-ui (also chakra-ui/park-ui). License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cschroeter/park-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 cschroeter). Pricing free.
